title: Robin counting functions on cuboids in the critical scaling regime
summary: We consider eigenvalue counting functions of Robin Laplace operators on cuboids where the Robin parameter and the spectral cut-off $λ$ are coupled. Our main focus is the critical regime, in which the Robin parameter is proportional to $\sqrtλ$. We obtain a two-term asymptotic expansion for the counting functions in this coupled setting. In the critical regime, the second term in the asymptotic expansion depends non-trivially on the proportionality constant and interpolates continuously between the corresponding second terms for the Dirichlet and Neumann Laplacians.
